text: Sabne EK hi khaana\nkhaya... mara sirf\nEK. Kaise?
Clue isi video\nmein hai.\nDhyaan se dekhna!
Sarpanch ARYAN ke\nghar raat ko\nKHICHDI bani...
Aryan ko khichdi\nmein upar se DESI\nGHEE pasand tha
Aadhi raat ko\nARYAN kursi par\nMARE mile!
"Bas ghee ki katori\ndene aaya tha...\nkhichdi nahi chhui"
Shivam ki nazar se\nkoi nahi bachta.
